about: Recorded answers from the 2026-11-16 Codex baseline run (gpt-6.1-sol answer, gpt-6-luna gate). Text and first-token/gate times are as recorded; chunking and pace after the first token are synthetic (charsPerSecond, chunkChars).

scenarios.name: ask-text
scenarios.markdown:
Retry design

A timeout proves the payment was not committed, so it is safe to retry with a new request ID.

The server commits before returning its HTTP response.
scenarios.passage: A timeout proves the payment was not committed, so it is safe to retry with a new request ID.
scenarios.tell: Challenge concrete contradictions with a question.
scenarios.response: {"type":"margin","quote":"A timeout proves the payment was not committed, so it is safe to retry with a new request ID.","kind":"question","text":"If the server commits but its HTTP response is lost, what prevents a retry with a new request ID from charging the customer twice?"}
scenarios.gateText: {"decision":"speak","reason":"If the server commits before its response is lost, how does a timeout prove the payment was not committed?","kind":"question"}
